main.description: Tells the AppView that one of the caller's app.activitytracker.space.athlete spaces exists, so it joins the space and indexes its activities. Requires service auth from the space's authority. Idempotent.

space.description: One of the caller's athlete spaces: at://{caller}/space/app.activitytracker.space.athlete/{tier}.

errors.name: NotSpaceAuthority
errors.description: The space's authority isn't the caller.

errors.name: UnsupportedSpace
errors.description: The space isn't an app.activitytracker.space.athlete space with a known tier key.
